summary: Creative Assembly's grand strategy/real-time tactics series, from historical PC strategy through Warhammer fantasy, Saga entries, mobile ports, and announced future Warcore-era projects.

primary.why: The original Total War is Windows-only and the Warlord/Gold package includes The Mongol Invasion expansion.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Warlord/Gold route with compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Medieval: Total War
entries.definitive_edition: Gold Edition / Battle Collection on Windows

primary.why: Medieval is Windows-only and the Gold/Battle Collection route includes Viking Invasion.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Gold/Battle Collection route with compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Rome: Total War
entries.definitive_edition: Total War: Rome Remastered on Windows

primary.why: Rome Remastered is the highest-fidelity official route for Rome and includes Barbarian Invasion and Alexander content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Total War: Rome Remastered on Windows; use original/mobile ports only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use original only for historical UI/mod comparison.

entries.title: Medieval II: Total War
entries.definitive_edition: Medieval II: Total War Definitive Edition on Windows

primary.why: The Windows Definitive Edition includes the Kingdoms expansion and remains the most complete/moddable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Definitive Edition; use mobile ports only for portability.

entries.remaster_caveats: No full remaster; mobile ports are portability routes.

entries.title: Spartan: Total Warrior

emulation.notes: Use Xbox emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: This action spin-off is console-only; Xbox is the highest-fidelity sixth-generation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox hardware or xemu; use PS2/GameCube only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Action spin-off, not a strategy Total War entry.

entries.title: Empire: Total War
entries.definitive_edition: Empire: Total War Definitive Edition on Windows

primary.why: The Windows Definitive Edition includes Warpath and is the most complete/moddable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Empire: Total War Definitive Edition on Windows; use mobile ports only for portability.

primary.why: Windows remains the highest-fidelity/moddable route and includes the Peninsular Campaign content in complete packages.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows complete/Definitive route; mobile ports are portability options only.

entries.title: Total War: Shogun 2
entries.definitive_edition: Total War: Shogun 2 Collection on Windows

primary.version: Collection / Fall of the Samurai complete route
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable route and complete packages include Rise and Fall of the Samurai content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Collection route; Fall of the Samurai can also be played as a standalone campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: Fall of the Samurai later became Total War Saga: Fall of the Samurai.

entries.title: Total War: Rome II
entries.definitive_edition: Emperor Edition/current complete route on Windows

primary.why: Windows Emperor Edition/current complete route is the most patched, moddable, and complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Emperor Edition/current build with desired DLC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Launch-state criticism makes current patch state important.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable route for Attila and its DLC campaigns.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches and desired DLC.

entries.title: Total War: Warhammer
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release as part of the Warhammer trilogy ownership set

primary.version: Windows release plus trilogy ownership for Immortal Empires context
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable route; owning Warhammer I contributes races/factions to later Mortal/Immortal Empires modes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release or use it as ownership content feeding Warhammer II/III combined campaigns.

entries.remaster_caveats: Combined-campaign value depends on owning multiple games/DLC.

entries.title: Total War: Warhammer II
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release with DLC as part of the trilogy set

primary.version: Windows release with DLC/Mortal Empires context
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable route, and Warhammer II is essential for the Mortal Empires/Immortal Empires trilogy content chain.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with desired DLC; use Warhammer III for the largest combined campaign.

entries.title: Total War Saga: Thrones of Britannia

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable route for this focused historical Saga entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable route and can include all chapter/DLC packs.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows current complete/Royal route with desired DLC.

entries.title: Total War Saga: Troy

primary.why: Windows Mythic/Ultimate package includes the Mythos expansion and is the most complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Saga subseries entry; record Mythos expansion state.

entries.title: Total War: Warhammer III
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows build with Immortal Empires and desired trilogy DLC

primary.version: Current Windows build with Immortal Empires
primary.why: Warhammer III with Immortal Empires is the largest and most complete official Warhammer Total War route, and Windows is the highest-fidelity/moddable platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build with Immortal Empires and desired trilogy DLC/ownership content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Completeness depends on trilogy ownership and DLC state.

entries.title: Total War: Pharaoh

primary.why: Pharaoh's free Dynasties update dramatically expands the game; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build with the Dynasties update installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Dynasties update is essential to the current recommendation.
